Higher Education Committee
Thursday, January 26, 2023
3:00 PMLivestream YouTube

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert D. Farnsworth,
Senator Robert J. Kupec, Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 3:08pm
S.F. 326: Senator Boldon: Summer academic enrichment program appropriation.

Senator Boldon presented SF 0326, an appropriation for Summer academic enrichment programming.

SF 0326 was laid over for possible inclusion.

Senator Fateh moved that S.F. 326, be laid over.
S.F. 267: Senator Fateh: Increase Teacher of Color Act in higher education strengthening.

Gavel was transferred to Vice Chair Putnam at 3:12pm.
Senator Fateh presented SF 0267, the Increase Teachers of Color Act.
SF 0267 was laid over for possible inclusion.

Gavel was returned to Chair Fateh at 4:03pm.

Senator Putnam moved that S.F. 267, be laid over.

The meeting was adjourned at 4:05pm

Uilegen

Senator Omar Fateh, Chair Chris Meyer,
